region.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single transparent pixel-art terrain sprite sheet for the cozy Korean desktop potion game Moonshade Apothecary.
The first reference is the approved visual style: extremely simple chunky 32px native sprites, dark plum outline, large flat color clusters, tiny warm details. The second reference identifies the existing regions ONLY; replace its noisy fine textures and excessive colors with the simple first reference style.
Create EXACTLY NINE separate terrain sprites in a STRICT evenly spaced 3 by 3 grid on an actual transparent canvas, each centered in its own equal square cell with at least 15% empty margin all sides. No titles, no letters, no UI, no labels or borders. All nine sprites same apparent scale, compact and puffy silhouettes, front view with slight top view and upper-left lighting, one native pixel outline #241C32. Sprite complexity suitable for native 32x32 pixels, enlarged nearest-neighbor, no antialiasing, gradients, tiny noise, dithering, shadows outside object. ONLY 4 or 5 colors per sprite INCLUDING outline.
Row1 left-right: 1 forest edge, two rounded sage trees with little amber path, colors #241C32 #718C59 #B5C77D #916047 #C99463; 2 abandoned greenhouse, squat cream-and-teal glasshouse with simple peaked wood roof and one green vine, colors #241C32 #916047 #9BE2CF #718C59 #FFF0BC; 3 mist valley, two stone cliffs bracketing a single turquoise waterfall into a pool, colors #241C32 #827589 #24566A #3BA8A3 #9BE2CF.
